title: Rhamondre Stevenson could be sidelined after late-game injury vs.
seoTitle: Rhamondre Stevenson Injury: Patriots Eye Jamaal Williams
subtitle: Coach Mike Vrabel seeks reinforcement as the team's top rusher appears injured
excerpt: In the 29-26 victory over the Buffalo Bills, Rhamondre Stevenson left injured, leading the New England Patriots to host running back Jamaal Williams for a workout.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In an unexpected 29-26 victory over the Buffalo Bills, New England Patriots starting running back Rhamondre Stevenson was seen struggling after being hit by three defenders on the final play. The incident raised questions about his physical condition and prompted the team to seek options in the market.

Stevenson's Injury on the Final Drive

During the Patriots' final drive, Stevenson received the ball, was tackled by three defenders, and left the field with a visibly injured ankle. He did not return to the game, and although he wasn't seen with a brace, his absence fueled speculation about the severity of the issue.

Patriots Work Out Jamaal Williams

In the same week, the New England Patriots hosted free agent running back Jamaal Williams in Foxboro for a workout. Williams, who has eight NFL seasons and led the league in rushing touchdowns in 2022, has been out of football for over a year after being released by the New Orleans Saints.

Running Back Depth

Currently, the Patriots' running back roster includes Rhamondre Stevenson, TreVeyon Henderson, and Corey Kiner. Henderson has filled in for Stevenson when he's been unavailable, and Kiner completes the rotation. The team also keeps Lan Larison on the practice squad.

Ground Game Performance

Through the first four games of the season, the Patriots' ground attack averages 3.9 yards per attempt, ranking 18th in the league. Stevenson and Henderson have already combined for 304 rushing yards and two touchdowns, contributing to one of the top ten rushing offenses.

Possible Developments

If the injury report confirms Stevenson's need for time off, the Patriots could rely on Henderson as an immediate replacement and evaluate signing Williams, who brings experience in short-yardage situations. The team still has two roster spots open after the release of edge rusher José Ramirez.

With information from 98.5 The Sports Hub, CBS Sports.
